catalysts.headline: Reported fiscal Q4 2026 results: record quarterly revenue $126.6M (+28% YoY), above $123-124M guidance; FY2026 revenue $459.4M (+22% YoY), gross margin 52.4% (Q4 gross margin 53.1% vs 51.3% a year earlier); GAAP net loss narrowed to $20.6M (-$0.32/diluted share) from $27.1M (-$0.45/share) in Q4 FY2025; positive adjusted EBITDA of $2.2M in Q4, vs a loss of $7.8M a year earlier, hitting the company's breakeven target. Guided FY2027 revenue to $550M-$560M and Q1 FY2027 revenue to $130M-$132M.
